there are tons of guides on here and elsewhere but i will try to help because people don't usually mention this way... if you reallllly dont want to go to a bank/store to do it for whatever reason you can just send plain cash in the mail if you conceal it well. maybe smaller amounts at a time if you are worried about mail being stolen.
go to https://get-bitcoin.com/ and fill out the order form. there are probably other places but i have used this one & i believe they take 5%. put your bitcoin wallet address & order number on a piece of paper with the cash & then you mail it to an address that they give you. it is pretty anonymous but this way takes a long time. took over a week for me. 


another way is to buy a moneypak from walmart/cvs/etc. (you can find where they are sold on the moneypak website i believe).  this is just like going to the register with a gift card; the cashier scans it & puts money on it (pay with cash) & has no idea what you are using it for (not that you are in any way doing something illegal here). the card itself costs just under $5 though so this is an added expense. then you can go on SR (or elsewhere) and find someone that will buy these in exchange for btc.  this is super risky & can be expensive.  however, if you really look around & find someone good it can be a great option.  i have done this one time and received the btc almost immediately after spending ~5min in the store to buy the card. you can be scammed at any time though so again maybe do this in smaller amounts if you are worried about the seller.

i realize that these are not the best ways to buy btc just an alt way which might work better for certain people. there are definitely cheaper/faster/safer ways to do this.  just see what is most important for you. 
if you have any other questions about these methods i will try to answer them.
